paragraphs: A Guitar-Hero-style part-learning trainer for choirs. Sing your part into your phone. Notes scroll toward you, your voice draws a live pitch line, and every phrase climbs a mastery ladder until it's concert-ready.

Built for a young, high-level chamber choir (Poulenc, Ravel, Debussy, early Schoenberg), so it takes intonation seriously: cents-level feedback, a chord-aware just-intonation target, movable/fixed solfège and Chinese numbered notation (jianpu), and an atonal Zwölfton expert mode.
Live: (open on your phone, then Add to Home Screen).
features: Repertoire: import your choir's MusicXML (.musicxml, .xml, .mxl) or MIDI.
Parts, divisi voices, lyrics, tempo and key changes are read automatically. Built in: an original warm-up chorale (the Abendlied).
